subject.title: iOS: keychain save fails on fresh install (cal save failed / disconnected because it could not securely save)

question: What signed-build Keychain failure is occurring on a fresh iOS 2026.7.1 install, and which repair preserves the existing secure-storage boundary without introducing plaintext or silent fallback storage?
rationale: The report blocks first-run onboarding at a credential boundary, but the missing OSStatus and entitlement context make a speculative automated repair unsafe.

options.title: Diagnose then repair
options.body: Capture redacted OSStatus, accessibility state, access group, and signed entitlements from an affected device, then land the narrow Keychain fix with real-device fresh-install and upgrade proof.

options.title: Ship diagnostic instrumentation
options.body: First ship a security-reviewed build that exposes a safe error code and recovery action without logging or displaying the token.

options.title: Add insecure fallback
options.body: Allow onboarding to continue by storing the token outside Keychain, accepting a weaker credential boundary.

recommendation.title: Diagnose then repair
recommendation.body: Capture redacted OSStatus, accessibility state, access group, and signed entitlements from an affected device, then land the narrow Keychain fix with real-device fresh-install and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The documented ownership assignment covers both the iOS app and security, matching the decision boundary.
